perSessionHelp: Submit RPE separately for every session, including days with three or more sessions.
dailyWellnessHelp: Submit wellness once a day; submit post-training RPE separately for each session.
flagLegend: Red/yellow flags use administrator thresholds, not injury predictions. Grey means missing data.
loadFlagNote: Load points and bars use daily load thresholds only; the table also includes wellness and pain flags.
aggregateFlagNote: Team means and weekly sums cannot replace individual review; risk colors refer to individual daily records.
title: Daily team report
subtitle: A clearer picture of your team. One daily check-in at a time.
demoNotice: Demo changes last for this browser session and reset on refresh.
overviewSub: Connect everyday training with long-term performance.
saveError: Save failed. Check permissions and input.
note: Load metrics support training decisions and must not be used alone to predict injury. Missing days are not zero load. Ratios require sufficient history.
medicalSub: Medical records are limited to administrators and authorized medical staff.
security: Data access protected by Supabase RLS
reportFooter: For training management only · “—” means missing or restricted. Rest days have zero load.
adminInfo: Manage invitations and permissions in the sections below.
printHint: Select “Save as PDF” in the print dialog.
importOrPasteFromExcelGoogleSheetsInclud: Or paste from Excel / Google Sheets including headers
importFixAllErrorsBeforeSavingNoRecords: Fix all errors before saving. No records have been imported.
importHelp: One row = one athlete, date and session. Use three rows for three sessions. Existing submissions are preserved by default; review the preview before saving.
sessionTemplateHelp: The sheet includes the full assigned roster. Fill RPE on pending rows to submit; leave it blank to keep pending. Existing values are exported and protected by default.
importFormatHelp: Use template English headers. Identify athletes by athlete_id or athlete_number + exact team_id/team. Use text YYYY-MM-DD dates and session_id or session_code + date + team. Maximum 500 rows / 2 MB. XLSX reads the first sheet, values only; formulas are rejected.
membershipHelp: Team selection adds membership; existing memberships are retained.
advancedAccountsHelp: Invite the account in Supabase Auth first, then register its UUID here. Passwords are managed by Supabase Auth.
signupHelp: For administrators creating a new organization. Invited athletes and staff should use their invitation link.
resetHelp: We will send a reset link to your registered email address.
loginHelp: Athletes enter their own records. Coaches review their team and can enter records on athletes’ behalf.
firstAdmin: Create your first organization as administrator
resetSent: If this address is registered, a reset email will arrive. Please check your inbox.
confirmationSent: Confirmation email sent. Open its link to verify your email before signing in.
connectionError: Unable to connect. Check your connection and try again.
invalidCredentials: The email address or password is incorrect.
emailUnconfirmed: Verify your email using the confirmation link before signing in.
accountExists: An account already exists for this address. Sign in or reset your password.
emailLimit: Too many requests. Wait a while before requesting another email.
weakPassword: Choose a different strong password with at least 10 characters.
accountLoadError: Unable to load your account. Ask your administrator to check the database connection and migrations.
joinHelp: Register and verify the email address you gave your administrator. Your role and team are set by the invitation.
invitationError: Unable to accept. Check the invited email, email verification and 7-day expiry. If you already belong to another organization, contact your administrator.
joinConfirmed: Confirmation email sent. Open its link, then accept the invitation.
haveAccount: Already have an account? Sign in
invalidInvitationHelp: Open the complete link provided by your administrator.
passwordChanged: Password updated. You can return to your team.
setupHelp: Create your organization and first team as administrator. Invited athletes and staff should open their invitation link instead.
setupError: Unable to create. Check email verification and database migrations.
setupNote: This account will be the administrator. Invite athletes from Settings.
connectionHelp: The database for team records is not configured. Athletes and staff can sign in here after the administrator completes setup.
connectionAdmin: Administrator: configure NEXT_PUBLIC_SUPABASE_URL and NEXT_PUBLIC_SUPABASE_PUBLISHABLE_KEY on the hosting service. Do not use a service role key.
inviteHelp: Issue a link for the person’s email and role, then share it with them. Create athlete records first; coaches can enter data for athletes without accounts.
inviteDemo: Invitations are unavailable in the demo. Connect Supabase to use this feature.
inviteCreated: Invitation link created. Share it with the intended person.
inviteError: Unable to create invitation. Check the email, role, team and unlinked athlete record.
inviteLink: Share this link (shown only when created)
copyHelp: Select the link field and copy it.
inviteLoadError: Unable to load invitations. Ask the administrator to check database setup.
syncError: Sync failed. The displayed data may be out of date.
calculationHelp: Coupled ACWR = (7-day sum / 7) ÷ (28-day sum / 28). Uncoupled uses the preceding 28 days. EWMA: λ = 2 / (N + 1), initialized at the first observation; at least N days required. Monotony = 7-day mean / population SD; zero SD → —. Strain = weekly load × monotony.
importInvalidFile: Invalid spreadsheet. Check the format or export a new template with values only.
importExportError: Unable to export. Select a session with assigned athletes.
importFailed: Import failed. Check permissions and the preview, then try again.
importDuplicate: Duplicate athlete/date/session. First entry is on row {row}.
importUnknownTeam: Team not found or ambiguous. Use team_id or the exact unique team name.
importUnknownAthlete: Athlete not found or ambiguous. Check athlete_id or the jersey number and team.
importUnknownSession: Session not found or ambiguous for this date and team.
importNotAssigned: The athlete is not assigned to this session.
importWrongSession: The row refers to a different session from the one selected.
importDateError: Use a valid date in YYYY-MM-DD or YYYY/M/D format.
importAttendanceError: Check attendance, minutes (integer 0–600) and RPE (0–10). Rest or absence requires 0 minutes and blank RPE.
importWellnessError: Sleep must be 0–24 hours and weight 20–300 kg.
importForbidden: Only authorized administrators and coaches can import records.
importFormulaError: Formulas are not accepted. Paste values only.
importExternalError: Macros and external links are not accepted. Use a plain template with values only.
importHeadersError: Use the supplied English template headers once each, with no more than 20 columns.
importNoRows: Include a header and at least one data row.
importLimitError: The sheet exceeds import limits. Use at most 500 data rows, 20 columns and 2 MB; remove unused formatted rows.
endTimeError: End time must be after start time.
submittedAthleteError: An athlete with a submitted response cannot be removed.
thresholdSleepError: The red sleep threshold must be at or below yellow.
thresholdPainError: The red pain threshold must be at or above yellow.
thresholdLoadError: The red load threshold must be above yellow.
thresholdFatigueRangeError: Fatigue thresholds must be within the configured scale.
thresholdFatigueDirectionError: The red fatigue threshold must indicate at least as much fatigue as yellow, following the scale direction.
importPendingRow: RPE left blank; submission remains pending.
